'''Permafrost crystals''' were rare [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. When used in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], they gave the blade an [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Color/Legends|blue]] color. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one [[permafrost]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] was in the possession of the [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Aurilia]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Properties==
[[Permafrost]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were deep, [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Color/Legends|blue]] crystals; this coloration was a trait they passed on to the blade of any [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into which they were incorporated. When one of the crystals was tuned by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] for use in a lightsaber, it became a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] and could only be used in lightsabers constructed by the individual who tuned it.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
The only known source of the permafrost crystals was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], although how they were created was a mystery.<ref name="SWGTCG" /> Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one of the crystals became the property of the [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Aurilia]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. A [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] in the township awarded one of them to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was instrumental in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The permafrost crystal is a unique lightsaber crystal in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It was added to the game on [[November 20]], [[2008]]. Permafrost, like all blue crystals in the game, causes the player character's lightsaber to deal additional cold damage when used. The vagueness of its history is due to the fact that, even though characters may take part in the Battle of Hoth in game, they may choose to fight on the side of either the Empire or the Rebel Alliance. They may then purchase the crystal for fifty "Echo Base Tokens of Heroism," a commodity of which player characters can get a maximum of nine for each flawless completion of the battle. Additionally, while characters may participate in the Battle of Hoth, which [[canon]]ically takes place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Chrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the game's [[Time/Legends|time]] frame of approx. [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] is not moved up to when the battle occurs.<ref name="SWG" /> The crystal also appears as an "Item" card in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' set ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]''.
